attrs.tool_parameters: {"bash_command":"wipnote","full_command":"wipnote feature set-description feat-3f66d83f \"Add a single helper for wipnote-owned Git mutations that acquires a repo-scoped advisory lock before running index/ref-writing Git commands. Use it to serialize concurrent agents and CLIs before Git's own index.lock contention path is reached. CONSTRAINT: the advisory lock only serializes wipnote's own processes; external writers (IDE, gitstatus daemon, user git) do not honor it, so the existing runGitWithLockRetry backoff loop MUST be retained as a complementary layer. flock auto-releases on process death, so wipnote's own lock can never go stale -- this is the rationale for flock over a pidfile.\" \\\n  --acceptance \"Concurrent wipnote processes are serialized via the advisory lock; runGitWithLockRetry is retained for external-writer contention; lock auto-releases if the holding process dies.\" \\\n  --expected-behavior \"Two wipnote autocommits launched simultaneously never both enter git's index-writing path at once; if one process is killed mid-commit, the lock is released automatically and the next process proceeds.\" && \\\nwipnote feature set-description feat-9704121b \"Add wipnote doctor support that reports active Git writers, lockfile age, repository operation state, and offers explicit stale index.lock cleanup only when no live Git process appears to own the repo. SAFETY: git index.lock is an empty file with no owner PID inside, so staleness must be inferred from live git processes against the repo plus lock age, not from lock contents; this detection is inherently racy. --fix is never the default; a final liveness re-check must run immediately before unlink.\" \\\n  --acceptance \"Detection uses lock age plus a live-git-process scan; dry-run is the default; --fix is opt-in and performs a final re-check immediately before deleting; never deletes when any live writer is detected.\" \\\n  --expected-behavior \"Running diagnostics reports lock age and active writers without modifying anything; --fix removes a lock only when it exceeds the age threshold AND no live git process is found, re-verified at the moment of unlink.\"","description":"Enrich descriptions of the two risk-bearing features"}

attrs.full_command:
wipnote feature set-description feat-3f66d83f "Add a single helper for wipnote-owned Git mutations that acquires a repo-scoped advisory lock before running index/ref-writing Git commands. Use it to serialize concurrent agents and CLIs before Git's own index.lock contention path is reached. CONSTRAINT: the advisory lock only serializes wipnote's own processes; external writers (IDE, gitstatus daemon, user git) do not honor it, so the existing runGitWithLockRetry backoff loop MUST be retained as a complementary layer. flock auto-releases on process death, so wipnote's own lock can never go stale -- this is the rationale for flock over a pidfile." \
  --acceptance "Concurrent wipnote processes are serialized via the advisory lock; runGitWithLockRetry is retained for external-writer contention; lock auto-releases if the holding process dies." \
  --expected-behavior "Two wipnote autocommits launched simultaneously never both enter git's index-writing path at once; if one process is killed mid-commit, the lock is released automatically and the next process proceeds." && \
wipnote feature set-description feat-9704121b "Add wipnote doctor support that reports active Git writers, lockfile age, repository operation state, and offers explicit stale index.lock cleanup only when no live Git process appears to own the repo. SAFETY: git index.lock is an empty file with no owner PID inside, so staleness must be inferred from live git processes against the repo plus lock age, not from lock contents; this detection is inherently racy. --fix is never the default; a final liveness re-check must run immediately before unlink." \
  --acceptance "Detection uses lock age plus a live-git-process scan; dry-run is the default; --fix is opt-in and performs a final re-check immediately before deleting; never deletes when any live writer is detected." \
  --expected-behavior "Running diagnostics reports lock age and active writers without modifying anything; --fix removes a lock only when it exceeds the age threshold AND no live git process is found, re-verified at the moment of unlink."
